title: Hevy Strength Session Failure Rate
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hevy:workout
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(session_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by muscle_group
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Hevy workout records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each muscle group.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize session_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per muscle group.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which parts of your Hevy workout data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
